payload.blocks: Phase 4 (waiting lead slot) and through it phases 5 and 6. Phase 2 runs meanwhile.
payload.headline: Phase 4: where does admission read that a lead 'waits outside', now that parks are events, not phase-table rows?

parts.cause: The plan was written on 2026-11-24, before the park-by-event rule. A coordination-help event stops counting as open as soon as the supervisor drains it, while the phase stays parked, so the event alone cannot say 'still waits'. Plan 261122-0056 phase 5 (waitingOn) is still draft, so there is no reader to reuse.

options.cost: Phase 4 reads the question store instead of the phase table; footprint unchanged except the Questions crate read in supervisor.rs/portfolio.rs. About one unit.
options.does: A running plan waits outside when every not-done phase has an open owner question whose ref is plan:<dir>#phase-NN (or plan:<dir>). Read through the Questions crate at each wake; answered or acked means working again.
options.gain: Durable state with its own lifecycle, no new writer, no plan-file commits; unparks by itself when you answer; same meaning 0056 phase 5 gives waitingOn: person.
options.harm: A lead parked on another plan or an outside run (no question) still holds its slot.
options.label: Open owner questions per phase

options.cost: A change to core/skills/fgos-lead/SKILL.md (outside this plan's footprint) plus phase 4 as written.
options.does: Allow the lead one plan-file commit per park (phase status 'parked: <party>') and one per unpark, as the plan assumed; the reader stays as written.
options.gain: Covers every party (owner, other plan, outside run); phase 4 runs as written.
options.harm: Reverses part of the 19f91c530 rule; adds main commits (two per park) that the land door must serialize.
options.label: Phase table park, one commit

options.cost: Phase 5/6 lose the slot rule text; acceptance criterion 5 moves to 0056.
options.does: Retire phase 4; p-tyowvhthul is closed by plan 261122-0056 phase 6 (sleep and wake) instead.
options.gain: No interim rule to retire later (L10).
options.harm: A waiting lead keeps blocking admission until 0056 phase 6 lands (0056 is still draft).
options.label: Drop phase 4, wait for sleep

parts.recommendation: Open owner questions per phase: it reads a durable store that already exists, adds no commits to main, and is the long-wait case the backlog row describes.

scope.allows: Phase 4 reading the source of 'waits outside' you pick, inside its current footprint (plus a corrected phase-04 brief in the plan directory).
scope.forbids: Any change to the lead skill or other plans unless you pick option 2; any new plan field or new event kind.

parts.what: Phase 4 counts a live lead as not holding a working slot when every not-done phase of its plan is parked on another party, read from the park record in the plan's phase table (your answer q-eoxlvo7i4r). Since commit 19f91c530 (2026-11-25) the lead procedure forbids landing a park in the plan file: a park is a coordination-help event on the supervision queue plus, for an owner wait, an open question. So the phase table holds no park record to read.
